exit: Some(1)
--- stdout ---
Usage: BIN --input <file.obj|file.glb|dir> --output <output.obj|output.glb|dir> [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <file|dir>      Input .obj or .glb file to remesh (required).
                              A directory remeshes every .obj and .glb
                              in it (non-recursive); --output is then a
                              directory (created if missing) and each
                              input foo.ext is written as <dir>/foo.ext.
  -o, --output <path>         Output file path (required): .obj writes
                              OBJ, .glb writes GLB (quads triangulated).
                              A directory in batch mode (see --input).
  --report <report.txt>       Write a stats report file (optional)
  --target-quads <count>      Target quad count (default: 50000,
                              ignored when --lods is given)
  --lods <q0,q1,...>          Emit a full LOD chain in one run, e.g.
                              --lods 10000,5000,2000 writes
                              <stem>_lod0.<ext>, <stem>_lod1.<ext>, ...
                              next to --output, keeping its extension
                              (overrides --target-quads)
  --edge-scaling <factor>     Edge scaling factor (default: 1.0, range: 1.0-4.0)
  --sharp-edge <degrees>      Sharp edge dihedral angle threshold
                              (default: 90.0, range: 30.0-180.0)
  --smooth-normal <degrees>   Smooth normal angle threshold
                              (default: 0.0, range: 0.0-180.0)
  --adaptivity <value>        Curvature-adaptive quad density
                              (default: 1.0, range: 0.0-1.0)
  --anisotropy <value>        Curvature-adaptive quad elongation
                              (default: 1.0, range: 0.0-1.0)
  --model-type <organic|hardsurface>
                              Model type hint (default: organic)
  --symmetry <off|auto|x|y|z>  Mirror-symmetry constraints
                              (default: off). auto detects the dominant
                              plane; x/y/z pin it. Falls back to
                              unconstrained output when the input scores
                              below threshold on the chosen plane
  --guides <file>             Guide-curve constraints: quad edge flow
                              follows the polylines (eye/mouth loops).
                              File format: one 'x y z' point per line,
                              blank lines separate polylines, '#' starts
                              a comment. Points live in input-mesh
                              coordinates. Single-file and --lods runs
                              only (rejected in batch mode)
  --features <file>           Sharp/feature constraints: crisp edges
                              along the polylines (hard-surface props).
                              Same file format as --guides: one
                              'x y z' point per line, blank lines
                              separate polylines, '#' starts a comment.
                              Points live in input-mesh coordinates.
                              Single-file and --lods runs only
                              (rejected in batch mode)
  --density <file>            Local density control: one multiplier
                              per input vertex (OBJ v-line order),
                              1.0 = unchanged, range 0.25-4.0 (values
                              outside clamp). '#' starts a comment.
                              Strong localized refinement saturates
                              (~2.3x realized for 4x asks); mild masks
                              realize nearly fully. Single-file and
                              --lods runs only (rejected in batch mode)
  --dipoles <off|auto>         Density-boundary dipole insertion:
                              singularity rings along sharp --density
                              steps unlock localized refinement
                              (default: auto; fires on asks
                              above ~2.5x, mild masks unaffected)
  --dipole-every <count>       Dipole dose stride override: place
                              every k-th ring candidate (default: 0
                              = auto line-ending estimate)
  --dipole-ratio <value>       Dipole step-sharpness override:
                              minimum face-key ratio (default: 0 =
                              auto 1.5)
  --uvs <on|off>              Emit remeshed UVs from the internal
                              parameterization (default: off). OBJ
                              gains vt lines + v/vt corners, GLB gains
                              TEXCOORD_0. Off keeps every output byte
                              identical to before
  --quiet                     Silence progress and info output; only
                              warnings, errors and the report print
  -h, --help                  Show this help
  -v, --version               Show version
